executionBoundaries: after application SQLite migrations on every database open
runtime.offlineImporterCompatibility: the schema-28 importer never overwrites a newer owner-bound schema-v1 equipment document with an older legacy JSON source; a genuinely newer source revision remains importable
runtime.transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE across every changed sheet and group inventory document

sourceResolution.canonicalIdentity: exact canonical name or reviewed alias from data/reference/items.json
sourceResolution.pokemonPrecedence: Trainer inventories whose currentTeam or boxedPokemon contains the Pokemon sheet slug
sourceResolution.groupFallback: group inventories are considered only when no eligible Trainer source row exists
sourceResolution.eligibleSource: one stable, uniquely identified, positive-quantity canonical row
sourceResolution.stackCapacity: authoritative positive integer quantity with one unit moved per assignment
sourceResolution.missingRowIdentity: allocate a deterministic bounded row identity before source evaluation

conversion.legacyEffectiveFieldsAfterMigration: clear equipmentSlots values and items.held after explicit state captures the canonical instance or unresolved legacy display value
conversion.inventoryMovement: remove one whole equipment row or decrement one stack unit in the same transaction
conversion.sheetRevision: increment once for each changed document
conversion.updatedAt: advance the prior authoritative timestamp by exactly one

initialActivity.policy: P8-043 must bind reviewed compatibility and a definition hash before activation

unresolved.duplicateCanonicalAssignments: invalid-assignment because handedness or multiple-copy intent cannot be inferred
unresolved.gmPresentation: show slot, retained display value, safe reason, and candidate count without raw source row identity

failurePolicy.preExistingValidAuthority: preserve assigned instances; retire matching legacy shell values and remove any persisted derived player projection
failurePolicy.unrepresentedLegacyBesideExplicitAuthori: preserve as an inactive invalid-assignment issue and increment the equipment semantic revision
failurePolicy.conflictingLegacyBesideExplicitAuthority: fail and roll back every document
failurePolicy.malformedOrOwnerMisboundAuthority: fail and roll back every document
failurePolicy.ambiguousAssignment: preserve as unresolved without inventory movement
failurePolicy.unknownCanonicalIdentity: preserve as unresolved without web, prose, or fuzzy lookup

normalization.newSheets: create a complete empty owner-bound equipmentState
normalization.loadedExplicitState: strictly parse and bind to the owning sheet kind and slug
